missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Площадка' stays in the nominative as the subject after 'есть'. 'Детская' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'во дворе' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Площадку' is the accusative direct object of 'строят'. 'Новую' agrees in the feminine accusative, and 'рабочие' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Площадки' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express what is missing. 'Удобной' agrees in the feminine genitive, and 'рядом' means nearby.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. 'Площадке' is in the dative case after 'к', marking the goal of motion. 'Дети' is the nominative plural subject of 'бегут'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after за. 'Площадкой' takes the instrumental case after 'за' to show position beyond. 'Лес' is the nominative subject of 'начинается'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after на. 'Площадке' is in the prepositional case after 'на' to mark where the action happens. 'Маленькие дети' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative after на with motion. 'Площадку' is accusative after 'на' because there is movement toward it. 'Гулять' states the purpose of going.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. 'Площадок' takes the genitive plural after 'много', with the fleeting vowel inserted. 'Спортивных' agrees in the genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Площадки' is the nominative plural subject. 'Эти' agrees in the plural, and 'полны людей' uses the genitive 'людей' after the short adjective.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after на. 'Площадке' is in the prepositional case after 'на' to mark the location of the plane. 'Взлётной' agrees, naming the runway pad.
